spans.s:
mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं)
Green, fresh, moist.
E.
अ neg. शुष्क dry.

Impurity.
2

Disgrace, degradation.
mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि)
Foul, impure.
E.
अ neg. शुचि purity.

n. (-त्वं)
Impurity.
E.
त्व added to अशुचि; also अशुचिता.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1

Impure.
2

Inaccurate.
3

Unknown, unascertained.
E.
अ neg. शुद्ध pure.

m. (-कः)
A vagrant, a suspicious character.
E.
अशुद्ध unknown, वास abode, कन् added.

f. (-द्धिः)
Impurity.
mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
Impure.
E.
अ neg. शुद्धि purity.

Sin.
2

Misfortune.
mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Unlucky.
E.
अ priv. शुभ good.

f. (-षा)
Inattention, neglect of service or respect.
E.
अ neg. शुश्रूषा service.

m. pl. always, (असवः)
The five vital breaths or airs of the body.
n. (-सु)
1 Reflexion, thought, or the heart as the seat of it.
2 Affliction.
E.
अस to be, &c. and उ Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-शुः-शुः-शु)
Going quickly, fleet, fast.
mn. (-शुः-शु)
Rice ripening in the rainy season.
n. adv. (-शु)
Quick, quickly.
E.
अशू to pervade, उण् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Difficult, arduous.
E.
अ neg. सुकर easy.

n. (-णं)
See असूक्षण.

n. (-णं)
Disrespect.
E.
अ implying modification, सूर्क्ष to disrespect, affix ल्युट्, the र is rejected; it is also written असुक्षण and असूर्क्षण.

n. (-खं)
Sorrow, pain, affliction, &c.
E.
अ neg. and सुख pleasure.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Producing unhappiness.
E.
असुख and आवह what bears.

mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि)
Unhappy, sorrowful, afflicted.
E.
असुख and इनि aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Causing or ending in unhappiness.
E.
असुख and उदय rising.

mfn. (-र्कः-र्का-र्कं)
Productive of or ending in unhappiness.
E.
असुख and उदर्क subsequent.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Difficult of attainment or accomplishment, hard, unattainable.
2 Difficult to be understood.
E.
अ neg. सु easily, गम going.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Childless.
E.
अ neg. सुत a son, &c.

n. (-णं)
Life, existence.
E.
असु vital air, and धारण possession.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Disagreeable, unpleasant, offensive.
E.
अ neg. सुनिरस agreeable.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Plain, ugly.
2 Improper, unbecoming.
E.
अ neg. सुन्दर handsome.

mfn. (-मृत्)
Living, alive.
E.
असु and भृत् possessing.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Living, breathing.
m. (-मान्)
Life, the principle of vitality, the portion of spirit connected with the attributes of existence.
E.
असु vital air, and मतुप् posses. aff.

mf. (-रः-रा)
An Asura or demon: the Asuras are children of DITI by KAŚYAPA; they are demons of the first order, and in perpetual hostility with the gods.
m. (-रः)
The sun.
f. (-रा)
1

Night.
2

A zodiacal sign.
3 A prostitute.
f. (-री)
1 Black mustard, (Sinapis ramosa.)
2 The wife of an Asura.
E.
अ neg. and सुर a deity; or अस् to send, to cast, &c. and उरन् Uṇādi affix, टाप् and ङीप् for the fem.; or अ neg. and सुरा spirituous liquor, personified as a damsel produced at the churning of the ocean, who was rejected by the demons and received by the gods.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Infernal, demoniac, belonging or relating to the Asuras.
m. (-रः)
1 An Asura or demon.
2 A form of marriage, in which the bridegroom gives to the bride, her father and paternal kinsmen, as much as he can afford.
n. (-रं)
Black salt.
f. (-री)
1 A division of medicine, surgery, curing by cutting with instruments, applying the actual cautery, &c.
2 Mustard.
E.
असुर a demon, अण् and in the fem. ङीप्.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Perishable, volatile, transitory.
E.
अ neg. सु easy, रक्षा preservation.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
Difficult of retention or preservation.
E.
अ neg. सु easily, रक्ष्य to be kept.

m. (-पुः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
असुर and रिपु an enemy, the foe of the Asuras.

f. (-सा)
A sort of basil, (Ocymum pilosum.)

n. (-ह्वं)
Bell metal.
E.
असुर and आह्वा a name: named after an Asura; struck at seasons of worship, and deterring his approach.

n. (-णं)
See असूर्क्षण.

n. (-णं)
Disrespect.
E.
See असूक्षण; it is also written असुर्क्षण.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Difficult of attainment.
E.
अ neg. सुस्तभ easily got.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Dearly beloved.
m. (-मः)
1 A husband.
2 A lover.
E.
असु life, सम equal to.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Unwell, uncomfortable.
E.
अ neg. सुस्थ well.

m. (-हृत्)
An enemy.
E.
अ neg. सुहृत् a friend.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Calumnious, scandalous, detracting, depreciating.
E.
असूञ् to calumniate, वुन् aff.

mfn. (-क्ष्मः-क्ष्मा-क्ष्मं)
Large, thick, gross.
E.
अ neg. सूक्ष्म fine.

f. (-तिः)
1 Non-production, obstruction, removal.
2 Barrenness.
E.
अ neg. सूति bringing forth.

m. (-तिः)
Distilling, distillation.
E.
आङ्, षूञ्^1 to produce, affix क्तिन्.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

n. (-नं)
Calumny, detraction.
E.
असूय to detract from, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-या)
Calumny, detraction.
f. (-या)
The wife of the sage ATRI.
E.
असूञ् to detract from, a nominal root, and यक् aff.

m. (-युः)
Calumny.
E.
असूय to calumniate, उ aff.

f. (-श्या)
The wife of a king or a great man.
E.
अ neg. सूर्य्य the sun, and पश्या who sees; who never sees the sun; being shut up in the Zenana.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Doing any thing quickly, smart, active.
2 (In medicine) Operating speedily.
E.
आशु and कारिन् what acts.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Going or moving quickly, swift, fleet.
m. (-गः)
1 The wind.
2 An arrow.
E.
आशु quick, and ग who goes.

f. (-त्री)
A tree which yields frankincense, (Boswellia serrata). see शल्लकी.

m. (-हिः)
Rice ripening in the rainy season.
E.
आशु quick, and व्रीहि rice; that is, of rapid growth; also आशु. so आशुधान्य n. (-न्यं) and other compounds.

Fire.
2

Wind, air.
E.
आशु before शुष to dry in the reiterative form, and अनि Uṇādi aff.

m. (-लः)
1 A sacrificer at the full and change of the moon.
2 A distiller.
E.
आसुति and बलच् aff.
